scope: Pure placement model using accepted TF1 r2 and pinned recovery ledger under trusted injected-adapter assumptions. This supersedes the candidate pending-review status only; it does not accept host wiring.
behavior: Private factory binds fresh ledger and exact boundary clock/origin; no registry bypass or job reopen is exposed. Phase table and credit arithmetic remain unchanged.

Callback admission and completion preserve the first fatal, original phase and scoped deadlines. Actual pending native-Promise settlement precedes completion. Successful guard-to-effect order remains synchronous.
Every admitted failed guard finishes UNKNOWN once and retains its credit. A guard-body BUDGET records sanitized context while actual ledger failure controls the terminal result.
Fatal effect paths retain exact trusted rejected performed evidence per attempt. Ordinary throws remain UNCERTAIN and do not authorize a retry.

additionalAuditorDistinctions.R02b: Valid late-ledger case changes readiness admission and recovery routing.
additionalAuditorDistinctions.M02: Exact deadline changes H count and bodyFailure, while gateway still prevents unsafe bridge execution.

qualifiedRedundancy.R02a: Original origin binding and monotonic clock floor retain future-origin defense.
qualifiedRedundancy.R07b: Persistent fatal and live admission retain callback cutoff; two extra cached ledger snapshots remain observable.

mutationAccounting.independentReplayLimit: Most 53 mappings use source and existing frozen execution evidence. M01 accounting and S02b diagnostics were independently replayed; the auditor separately replayed the four survivors.

limitations: This focused matrix is not exhaustive over every BUDGET, deadline, malformed shape and optional route combination.
Standalone exported mapper and readiness helpers retain legacy contracts; TF1 containment belongs to placement wrappers.
Trusted inert adapters and native Promises are required; arbitrary Proxy/thenable and nonsettling containment are unproved.
Caps are synthetic and unapproved. No actual host clock mapping, PostgreSQL, HTTP, native capture, transport, production integration, deployment or new host GO.
Root accepts local composition eligibility only. PM-1 S1 and operational gates remain unchanged.
